pages.title: Demolition Tycoon 3D
pages.creator: Vellmont Games
pages.description: Demolition Tycoon 3D lets you build a demolition fleet by bringing down buildings. Hold to strike sections, earn coins, and improve power, speed, profit, or critical-hit chances. Buy larger machines as you complete contracts across different districts.

pages.title: Mononinja
pages.creator: ByteOsy
pages.description: Mononinja challenges you to guide a ninja through deadly platform courses. Hold the jump button to control height, releasing sooner for a smaller leap. Judge each landing carefully while working through more than thirty obstacle-filled levels.

pages.title: i8 City Driver
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: i8 City Driver gives you a supercar to customize and drive around an open city. Use nitro to pass traffic and attempt speed, stunt, or driving missions with your dog. Upgrade the car to try more demanding challenges.

pages.title: Tower Stack 2026
pages.creator: Aman Bhai
pages.description: Tower Stack 2026 is a timing game about building a taller tower from dropped blocks. Tap or click when the next piece lines up with the stack. Keep the placements accurate to continue adding height.

pages.title: Classic Mahjong
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Classic Mahjong asks you to clear a solitaire layout by pairing matching symbols. Select accessible tiles and use their removal to uncover more of the board. Flower tiles can pair with other flowers, and season tiles with other seasons.

pages.title: Cyber Arrow
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Cyber Arrow puts a remote-controlled arrow at the center of a science-fiction adventure. Guide it with a joystick, draw a path, or select enemies as waypoints depending on the level. Defeat opponents, solve puzzles, and rescue hostages across three modes.

pages.title: Strange packages
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Strange Packages begins in an apartment where unexplained parcels keep arriving. Inspect objects, read notes, and collect clues while investigating the increasingly unsettling events. Use inventory items on the surroundings to work through the mystery.

pages.title: Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Bid Wars 1: Auction Simulator makes you compete for storage units, antiques, and mysterious lots. Look for promising items and decide how much to bid against the other buyers. Choose carefully so the discovered contents support your auction business.

pages.title: Clinic Cleanup Crew
pages.creator: yiyuan
pages.description: Clinic Cleanup Crew puts you in charge of cleaning a health center. Sweep or mop floors, wipe surfaces, and take away rubbish in the different areas. Complete each location's assigned chores to leave the clinic ready for visitors.

pages.title: Jump Man
pages.creator: Sanuk Games
pages.description: Jump Man is an endless jumping game built around chaining successful moves into combos. Keep the character's jumps going to increase the score. Try another run to build a longer sequence and improve your previous total.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter Billiards & Pool
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Bubble Shooter Billiards & Pool combines pool-ball styling with bubble-shooting puzzles. Aim the loaded bubble and match at least three of the same color to clear them. Swap to the next bubble when it offers a more useful shot.

pages.title: Panda Shop Simulator
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Panda Shop Simulator lets you grow a supermarket run by a panda. Develop the small shop, earn money, and hire assistants to help with the work. Upgrade its facilities as you expand the store into a larger business.

pages.title: Cyber Monday
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Cyber Monday is a block-pushing puzzle about building a bridge to the goal. Move pieces into the grid to create a route for the character. Placed blocks cannot simply be removed, so plan the path within the level's move limit.

pages.title: Drift Donut
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Drift Donut challenges you to keep a car sliding around donut-shaped roads. Click or tap to start drifting and stay on the available track to earn points. Clear more roads and use the progress to unlock additional cars.

pages.title: Christmas Snowball Arena
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Christmas Snowball Arena puts you against nine rivals in a snowball-growing contest. Collect snow blocks and free snowballs to increase your size, then defeat opponents and absorb their snow. Work toward being the last player standing in the arena.

pages.title: Words from words: Sea
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Words From Words: Sea asks you to form words from a circle of letters. Connect the letters to fill the crossword spaces and uncover the hidden answers. Keep finding useful combinations as new word layouts become available.

pages.title: 2248 Musical
pages.creator: Friendzy
pages.description: 2248 Musical combines number-tile connections with musical feedback. Join tiles to double their values and continue building larger numbers. Each connection adds to the sounds of the game as you work toward a higher result.

pages.title: Party Animals Cats Evolution
pages.creator: AY Indie
pages.description: Party Animals Cats Evolution lets you merge identical kittens into new cat types. The cats produce coins that can buy more animals or useful boosters. Keep combining the collection to discover later stages of the evolution chain.

pages.title: Halloween Monster Traffic
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Halloween Monster Traffic asks you to help small monsters cross busy roads. Watch the cars and tap when a safe gap opens. Guide them through the crossings while responding to the different obstacles in each level.

pages.title: Fantasy Typing
pages.creator: Cat Summer
pages.description: Fantasy Typing makes accurate typing your means of fighting through a magical world. Enter the displayed words to battle creatures and bosses. Improve your typing abilities as you explore more of the realm and uncover its challenges.

pages.title: Guess it
pages.creator: Ringier Axel Springer Polska
pages.description: Guess It is a hidden-word puzzle based on short clues. Work out the missing word by identifying its letters and their positions. Complete the answers to earn points and try to improve the score from your earlier attempts.

pages.title: My Cute Unicorn Fashion Dress Up
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: My Cute Unicorn Fashion Dress Up lets you style Skyler, Sunny, Ruby, and Violet for a unicorn-themed party. Browse the wardrobe choices and combine clothing or accessories for each friend. Prepare the group for their weekend celebration.

pages.title: Guardians of Gold
pages.creator: Freak X Games
pages.description: Guardians Of Gold follows miners trying to steal gold without a patrolling guard noticing. Tap to pass the gold between workers and get it into the trench. Finish the transfer within twenty-five seconds while watching the guard's position.

pages.title: Idle Country Tycoon
pages.creator: LoraStudio
pages.description: Idle Country Tycoon puts you in charge of developing businesses across different countries. Build and manage properties, including shopping malls, while expanding the operation. Switch regions to explore their different architectural settings and continue growing the portfolio.

pages.title: Backgammon Multi player
pages.creator: Tweensoft
pages.description: Backgammon Multi Player lets you join a lobby for a classic board-game match. Play against friends from other locations and move your pieces through the backgammon contest. Return to the lobby when you want another opponent or round.

pages.title: Stick Duel: The War
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Stick Duel: The War is a physics-based stickman fight against the computer or a friend. Use weapons and double jumps while accounting for each map's layout. Win five rounds to take the match across the game's twenty arenas.

pages.title: Red Ball Bounce
pages.creator: XTStudio
pages.description: Red Ball Bounce follows a ball fighting to rescue its love and stop enemies from reshaping the planet. Roll and jump through a dangerous factory, avoiding lasers and other hazards. Defeat opponents while finding a safe route onward.

pages.title: Jumping Ball
pages.creator: Gamebol
pages.description: Jumping Ball challenges you to keep a ball moving across difficult platforms. Use the mouse to manage the next jump and aim for a safe landing. Falling from the platform ends the attempt, so judge the route carefully.

pages.title: Zentangle Coloring Book
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Zentangle Coloring Book gives you patterned illustrations to fill with color. Choose shades for the repeating shapes and decorative sections, building a design one area at a time. Experiment with the available palette to finish your own version of the artwork.

pages.title: Zen Triple 3D
pages.creator: Albayoo
pages.description: Zen Triple 3D is a matching puzzle inside a rotatable ball of objects. Turn the view to find three identical pieces and remove them. Keep searching the different angles until the container is completely cleared.

pages.title: Idle Farming Business
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Idle Farming Business lets you buy land, plant crops, harvest, and sell the produce. Upgrade crops for better output and trigger sunshine or rain boosts when useful. Unlock more plots with new crops as the farm grows.

pages.title: Bubble Shooter - Farm Fruit
pages.creator: goolgames
pages.description: Bubble Shooter - Farm Fruit asks you to rescue small teddy bears from bubble arrangements. Aim carefully and pop matching groups to clear the route to them. Use angles and well-placed shots while working through twenty levels.

pages.title: Axel Dungeon
pages.creator: Gamealliz
pages.description: Axel Dungeon is a Sokoban-style puzzle about pushing crates onto marked spaces. Move around the dungeon grid and consider where each box can go before pushing. Complete every required placement without trapping a crate against the wrong wall.

pages.title: 4WD Race Legend
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: 4WD Race Legend lets you assemble parts into miniature racing cars and enter competitions. Try the available components and use earned rewards to unlock additional models. Develop the small vehicles while working through the racing challenges.

pages.title: Zombie Catcher Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Zombie Catcher Online follows an alien hired to retrieve zombies that escaped from a laboratory. Travel through different worlds with a weapon and jetpack, using bait and traps to catch them. Upgrade the equipment before the next group can get away.

pages.title: Popcorn Race 3D
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Popcorn Race 3D makes you guide a bare corn cob along a running course. Collect kernels and pass through machines that transform them into popcorn. Steer toward useful additions to develop the corn as it moves along the route.

pages.title: Day at school
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Day At School follows a child's first-day school routine through short interactive activities. Use touch input and the instructions shown on screen to complete each task. Explore different parts of the day as the classroom activities change.

pages.title: Rescue The Cute Little Girl
pages.creator: Flash From The Past
pages.description: Rescue The Cute Little Girl is an escape puzzle about helping Sophia out of a locked house. Search the location for clues and useful objects. Work through the puzzles to open a way out before leaving the stranded girl alone.

pages.title: Frescoz!
pages.creator: Absolutist Ltd.
pages.description: Frescoz! asks you to rebuild a picture from many small illustrated fragments. Study the pieces presented below and attach them to the correct places. Match each detail to the mural until the complete image comes together.

pages.title: Pop it fidget Toy
pages.creator: RN Gaming Studio
pages.description: Pop It Fidget Toy offers a collection of virtual pop-it toys. Choose a design and tap its bubbles to hear the popping sounds. Work across the surface or switch to another toy when you want a different pattern.

pages.title: AXE Master
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: AXE Master challenges you to hit fixed or moving targets with thrown axes. Tap to release a throw and judge where a moving target will be. Avoid bomb targets, since hitting one ends the attempt.

pages.title: Two Aliens Adventure
pages.creator: Misc.261 Games
pages.description: Two Aliens Adventure makes you control two aliens at the same time through platform hazards. Coordinate their movements so both stay safe on their routes. Gather all the gems to unlock the next challenge.

pages.title: Brain Tricky Puzzles
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Brain Tricky Puzzles asks you to answer questions by looking closely at the picture. Consider details that might change an apparently simple answer, then tap your choice. Try another approach when the obvious solution does not work.

pages.title: Island Monster OffRoad
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Island Monster OffRoad gives you monster trucks for hills, coastal terrain, and stunt ramps. Use their power to climb difficult sections or try jumps around the island. Drive alone or challenge a friend in split-screen two-player mode.

pages.title: Three Arcade
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Three Arcade combines three precision mini-games. Aim a ball at a yellow target, match a ball's color against shifting blocks, and work around moving obstacles. Adjust to each game's timing rather than using one approach for every challenge.

pages.title: Bloo Kid 2
pages.creator: winterworks GmbH
pages.description: Bloo Kid 2 is a side-scrolling platform adventure with jumps, enemies, and collectible routes. Move through the stages, use a second jump in the air, and drop through platforms when needed. Guide Bloo Kid through the family's next journey.

pages.title: Adam and Eve Crossy River
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Adam And Eve Crossy River asks you to guide both characters safely across a river. Click Adam or Eve to make the next crossing move. Time the steps to avoid drowning, giant crabs, and other dangerous animals.

pages.title: Russian Grand City Auto
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Russian Grand City Auto lets you explore a Russian city in a third-person action setting. Walk through the streets, take cars, and drive around the area. Switch the camera when you want another view of the city.

pages.title: Light Up
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Light Up is a connection puzzle about joining all the paths in a layout. Inspect the open ends and arrange them into the required route. Complete every connection so the board meets its goal.

pages.title: BOAR HUNTING JIGSAW
pages.creator: mastergame
pages.description: Boar Hunting Jigsaw is a hunting game in which you track and shoot wild boars. Move into position, line up the weapon, and fire at the running animals. Stay alert when a threatened boar turns to attack.

pages.title: Flying Dragon City Attack
pages.creator: ideagames
pages.description: Flying Dragon City Attack puts you in control of a dragon attacking ground targets. Fly over the city, identify the assigned targets, and use the dragon's attacks to destroy them. Complete the current objective before the level's time limit expires.

pages.title: Unlock Blox
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Unlock Blox asks you to make an exit route for a yellow block. Drag the other pieces away from its path and create enough room to move it out. Plan the sequence so the remaining blocks do not trap the target.

pages.title: NAZARE QUARANTINE
pages.creator: N2kStudio
pages.description: NAZARE QUARANTINE is a box-moving puzzle with both pushing and pulling controls. Use the arrows to move crates, or hold X beside a box to pull it. Rearrange the obstacles to work through the route.

pages.title: Doctor Pets
pages.creator: babygames.com
pages.description: Doctor Pets follows animals visiting a forest pet hospital. Choose a patient such as a dog, cat, rabbit, or monkey and work through the available care tasks. Use the game's tools to help the animal complete its appointment.

pages.title: Pixel Combat The SandStorm
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Pixel Combat The SandStorm is a pixel-styled shooter set during a zombie invasion. Fight alongside online players or take on campaign levels, choosing from different weapons and characters. Move through the maps while aiming at the enemies ahead.

pages.title: KTM Super Duke R Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: KTM Super Duke R Puzzle provides six motorcycle pictures as jigsaw challenges. Choose a puzzle with sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces. Place the sections correctly to rebuild the bike and its surroundings.

pages.title: Tank VS Golems
pages.creator: Arcade Lemon
pages.description: Tank Vs Golems puts a tank against incoming stone creatures. Move the vehicle into a useful position and fire to stop the approaching golems. Keep the weapon directed toward the threats so the tank can continue fighting.

pages.title: Planet Invasion
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Planet Invasion is a retro-styled spacecraft shooter. Guide the craft through enemy attacks while its weapons fire, collecting improvements along the way. Destroy opponents and extend the flight to keep increasing your score.

pages.title: Kunoichi Run
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Kunoichi Run is an endless-running challenge starring a female ninja. Guide the character through the changing route with mouse input or keyboard movement. Keep the run going to travel farther on the next attempt.

pages.title: Retro Fever
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Retro Fever combines music with a three-dimensional platforming challenge. Move with the keyboard and use jumps to get between platforms. Keep the character's progress under control while following the game's musical setting.

pages.title: Angry Flappy Birds
pages.creator: Onduck Games
pages.description: Angry Flappy Birds combines slingshot launching with a flapping obstacle course. Fire one of your three birds, then tap to keep it airborne. Guide the flight between pipes without hitting them and losing the attempt.

pages.title: Fruit Sudoku
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Fruit Sudoku replaces digits with fruit symbols in a logic grid. Fill each empty cell so every row, column, and three-by-three box contains each fruit once. Use the existing symbols to work out what belongs in the remaining spaces.

pages.title: Who wants to be a Millionaire
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Who Wants To Be A Millionaire is a multiple-choice quiz. Read a question and choose the correct answer from four options to reach the next stage. Keep answering accurately as you work through the question sequence.

pages.title: Snow Driving Car Racer Track Simulator
pages.creator: Flick Gamer
pages.description: Snow Driving Car Racer Track Simulator puts cars on snowy and icy racing roads. Choose a vehicle and control its slides through the slippery turns. Manage the car's grip while practicing faster runs around the winter tracks.

pages.title: Pretty Butterfly Coloring
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Pretty Butterfly Coloring offers eight butterfly pictures and twenty-three colors. Choose an image and fill its outlined sections with your preferred shades. Save the completed artwork before trying a different butterfly or color combination.

pages.title: Daily America Jigsaw
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Daily America Jigsaw lets you rebuild a collection of pictures from scattered puzzle pieces. Drag each section back into its correct place and use the available help tools when needed. Complete the image before choosing another puzzle.

pages.title: Snake Neon
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Snake Neon challenges you to guide a glowing snake toward food. Eat to increase the score while keeping away from other snakes and obstacles. Use the arrow keys or on-screen pad to steer through the available space.

pages.title: Candy Blast
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Candy Blast is a match-three puzzle with colored sweets. Drag the pieces to bring matching candies together and clear them from the board. Keep finding useful combinations as new arrangements appear during the game.

pages.title: Monsters' Wheels Special
pages.creator: SMOKOKO LTD
pages.description: Monsters' Wheels Special puts powerful vehicles into rough-terrain races and demolition battles. Climb hills, jump gaps, and ram opponents while collecting money for upgrades or new cars. Use nitro when a burst of speed helps you pass the opposition.

pages.title: Basketball Tournament 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Basketball Tournament 3D offers free-throw challenges across six modes. Aim at the basket and time the shot to build your score under each mode's rules. Practice the throws and work through the tournament's different shooting tasks.

pages.title: King of Jungle Jigsaw
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: King Of Jungle Jigsaw offers twelve pictures of jungle animals to assemble. Move the pieces into their correct positions and watch the available time. Complete the animal image before the countdown ends to continue through the collection.

pages.title: Evil Granny: Horror Village
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Evil Granny: Horror Village asks you to find treasure boxes and escape while Granny searches for you. Explore the village, interact with useful objects, and run when danger approaches. Gather the required boxes without getting caught by your pursuer.

pages.title: 3D KUNG FU FIGHT BEAT EM UP
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: 3D Kung Fu Fight Beat Em Up puts you into street fights against approaching thugs. Move into range and combine attacks with jumps or defensive actions. Use the different combat buttons to work through the opponents blocking your way.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Skin Doctor
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Dotted Girl Skin Doctor is a fictional skin-care game after Dotted Girl develops a rash. Select the available medical-style tools and work through the marked areas of her face. Complete the on-screen care steps to finish the appointment.

pages.title: Perfect Slices
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Perfect Slices challenges you to cut fruit and vegetables through a series of chopping levels. Use mouse or touch input to control the slicing. Keep the cuts going through the ingredients as you work toward completing each stage.

pages.title: Cartoon Flight
pages.creator: Piponga
pages.description: Cartoon Flight follows Miss Pilot through an obstacle-filled flight. Steer the aircraft around hazards while gathering coins and rewards. Keep the plane on a safe course to extend the journey and collect more along the way.

pages.title: Old Rusty Cars Differences 2
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Old Rusty Cars Differences 2 asks you to compare two pictures and find every changed detail. Select the differences before the timer ends, using a hint when needed. Finishing faster gives you a higher score for the search.

pages.title: BTS House Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS House Coloring Book lets you decorate house illustrations with chosen colors. Select an image, choose a shade for the brush, and fill the outlined sections. Experiment with the palette to build your own version of the scene.

pages.title: Didi & Friends Guess What
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Didi & Friends Guess What is a character-recognition puzzle. Look at the hidden figure, choose the matching picture, and drag it into position to reveal the answer. Keep identifying the shapes as Didi and the other characters appear.

pages.title: Totem Destroyer Redux
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Totem Destroyer Redux asks you to remove blocks without letting a golden idol fall to the ground. Choose a block and consider how its removal affects the structure's balance. Clear the required pieces while keeping the idol supported.

pages.title: EG Endless Car
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Endless Car is a driving chase about collecting cash and avoiding the police. Steer through the area toward useful money pickups while staying ahead of pursuit. Keep the car moving safely to extend the attempt.

pages.title: Monster Trucks Memory
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Monster Trucks Memory asks you to uncover matching pictures of monster trucks. Choose a mode, turn over two cards, and remember where the unmatched images appear. Find every pair to clear the board and finish the game.

pages.title: Flying Truck
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Flying Truck puts a cargo vehicle into an airborne obstacle course after the roads close. Click or tap to keep the truck flying and steer its height past the barriers. Continue the delivery attempt to build a higher score.

pages.title: Rebel Forces
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Rebel Forces is an online arena shooter with six maps and three modes. Fight other players while adapting to the room's selected settings. Options such as doubled speed, jump height, or health change how the battles play out.

pages.title: Drift Cars
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Drift Cars lets you drive a selection of cars and earn points through controlled slides. Steer into a drift and keep the vehicle under control to build your score. Earn money as you continue practicing the driving challenges.

pages.title: Fairy Make Up
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Fairy Make Up lets you work on a fantasy character's beauty look. Choose from the available makeup and styling options, then combine them into a finished appearance. Experiment with different selections to create a makeover for the fairy.

pages.title: Climb Rush
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Climb Rush challenges you to scale rock faces without missing a hold. Tap at the right moment to climb higher and avoid a fall. Earn diamonds for new characters while completing mountains and unlocking more levels.

pages.title: Cosmic Bee
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Cosmic Bee sends a bee flying between planets toward the final destination. Tap to launch the next movement and judge the route ahead. Keep progressing from one planet to the next until you reach the last one.

pages.title: Judys Throat Doctor
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Judys Throat Doctor is a fictional clinic game about helping Judy with throat problems. Select the displayed tools and use them on the marked areas inside her mouth. Complete the different care steps to finish the appointment.

pages.title: Frolic Car Parking
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Frolic Car Parking asks you to park twice in every level. Steer the vehicle into the first required position, then move on to the second. Plan the turns carefully so both parking tasks can be completed safely.

pages.title: Poison Ivy Flower Care
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Poison Ivy Flower Care lets you help Poison Ivy grow a strange plant from seed. Follow the available care activities as it develops into a new monster species. Work through each growth stage to see the finished creation.

pages.title: Wedding Planner
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Wedding Planner follows a couple choosing between two possible wedding venues. Help the planner decorate each location and prepare it for the couple's visit. Compare the finished settings before deciding where the wedding will take place.

pages.title: Unicorn Beauty Salon
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Unicorn Beauty Salon gives a unicorn a day of grooming and makeover activities. Use the available salon tools to care for the character, then complete its new appearance. Work through the treatment and styling steps to finish the visit.

pages.title: Swing Chopper
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Swing Chopper is an upward-flying arcade challenge with spikes to avoid. Use the mouse to control the next change in flight and find a safe route higher. Keep the character clear of hazards to extend the ascent.

pages.title: Burger Bar
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Burger Bar puts you behind the counter assembling food from the available ingredients. Check the recipe book, combine the right items and prepare the orders customers request. Keep the work area organized as you handle the next burger.

pages.title: Betsy's Crafts: Perler Beads Christmas
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Betsy's Crafts: Perler Beads Christmas lets you make festive bead pictures in a workshop. Choose a template and colors, place the beads into the design, and use the finishing activity. Try different patterns to create another Christmas craft.

pages.title: Princess Makeup Room
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Princess Makeup Room is a hidden-object search for misplaced makeup and hairstyling items. Inspect the princess's room and select the objects she needs. Find everything on the list to put her beauty supplies back in order.
